reply_text:
I posted the list as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod. Summary:

Vantorre Group tickets (Mobility excluded):
1. #8841 (Pemberline Dock carrier/kiosk issue). The sources conflict. Gideon said on Jul 1 he closed it. The May 4 digest says it's still open (Allentown, Dock Door 12). The Sep 30 digest says Mateo submitted it and it was escalated to platform engineering (Newark, Door 14).
2. PD-8841 (Apr 27 digest). Missed carrier check-ins at Allentown. The digest doesn't say whether this is the same ticket as #8841.
3. INC-4821 (Hartford status-page access). Gideon, #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3. Left open.
4. VT-55120 (root-cause ticket, Hartford kiosk outage). Gideon, #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14.

I also corrected myself in that reply. On Oct 14 I told the Hartford channel I had "logged" VT-55120. I have no ticket-system access, so that was false. The number only comes from Gideon's message. I haven't corrected it in #inc-vtg-hartford, where Mateo (Vantorre) and Odile (Carrowmere) can read it. Tell me if you want me to post that correction there.

Before the steering committee, someone should check the real ticket system for the status of #8841 and whether PD-8841 is the same ticket. The Aug 3 and May 3 digests and the cheat sheet mention support threads but list no ticket numbers.
